results.name: All ten levels have two appropriate visitors, with deterministic long pauses
Visitors stay at the edges and at most two appear; none occupies the central play area
Entry and exit start invisible; peeking visitors pause instead of constantly wobbling
Reduced motion removes every visitor and immediately clears the overlay
Blank ambient frames do no canvas work; visible visitors clear once and erase their last frame
Portrait phone and tablet draws use finite coordinates and balanced Canvas state
Warmed ambient frames reuse a bounded sprite atlas with no per-frame paths or gradients
Garden scene aliases use the same bounded visitors; invalid visual clocks are safe
